summary: Receives and plays audio associated with an NDI In TOP stream, making network video audio available as CHOP channels.
key_concepts: Audio NDI CHOP retrieves audio from an NDI In TOP stream.
The NDI In TOP parameter selects the source TOP whose network stream supplies audio.
Play controls whether the audio stream outputs signal or no audio.
The output can be modified with downstream CHOPs or routed to audio output/recording operators.
Time Slice and sample-rate matching follow common CHOP behavior for stream-oriented downstream networks.

key_params.name: play
key_params.note: Enable playback/output from the NDI audio stream

key_params.name: ndiintop
key_params.note: NDI In TOP source whose audio should be output

common_gotchas: Audio NDI depends on a working NDI In TOP stream; network discovery, firewall, and sender state affect availability.
NDI audio timing follows the network stream and may require buffering/sync management with video.
Choose a stable NDI In TOP reference rather than a temporary discovery node.
Use Audio Device Out or Audio File Out downstream depending on whether monitoring or recording is intended.
